name: Burdens
overview: Scripture reveals that burdens weigh heavily on the heart, yet God invites those who are weary and burdened to come to Him for rest, as Jesus promises in Matthew 11:28. Believers are encouraged to cast their burdens upon the Lord, who sustains and protects the righteous (Psalms 55:22), recognizing God as a refuge and strength in times of trouble (Psalms 46:1). Additionally, the call to bear one another's burdens reflects the communal responsibility within the body of Christ, while Deuteronomy 28:47 warns against serving God without joy, which can compound the weight of life's challenges.
